photo.credit: Wikimedia Commons · Sokol-KV2 IVA suit on display. The Soviet Sokol family — designed in 1973 after the Soyuz 11 fatal decompression — is the parent design of every modern launch-and-entry suit in service, including the Chinese Shenzhou IVA and (philosophically) the SpaceX Crew Dragon IVA.

see_in_app.context_key: Sokol KV-2, Sokol-M, Orlan-MKS, Feitian, A7L, A7LB, AxEMU, EMU, Krechet-94, ACES, SpaceX IVA, Starliner IVA, Shenzhou IVA — every spacesuit in the fleet catalogue traces back to one of three design lineages described in this article
Apollo 11–17 (A7L / A7LB), all post-1973 Soyuz flights (Sokol family), all Shuttle EVAs (EMU), Shenzhou EVAs (Feitian), Artemis II/III (AxEMU)
